_note: Governed metric catalogue for arm 3 (#95). The model only chooses a metric and its arguments; the SQL below is fixed, reviewed, and rendered by code with whitelisted arguments. Designed generically from the table, not from the question sets.

peak.description: Highest value of a column in one region (or ALL regions) with where and when it occurred. args: column(demand|price), region(region|ALL)
peak.sql: SELECT {col}, region, settlement_ts FROM price_demand {where} ORDER BY {col} DESC, settlement_ts LIMIT 1

count_where.description: Number of 5-minute intervals in one region where a column is above or below a threshold. args: region, column(demand|price), op(above|below), threshold(number)
count_where.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM price_demand WHERE region = '{region}' AND {col} {op} {threshold}

average.description: Simple average of a column in one region, optionally over a window (start exclusive, end inclusive, settlement timestamps). args: region, column, start(optional 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'), end(optional)
average.sql: SELECT avg({col}) FROM price_demand WHERE region = '{region}' {window}

weighted_average_price.description: Demand-weighted average price in one region. args: region
weighted_average_price.sql: SELECT sum(rrp * total_demand_mw) / sum(total_demand_mw) FROM price_demand WHERE region = '{region}'

top_region_by_average.description: The region with the highest simple average of a column. args: column
top_region_by_average.sql: SELECT region FROM price_demand GROUP BY region ORDER BY avg({col}) DESC LIMIT 1
